Record date 2026-12-15, pay date 2027-01-12, USD 8,000,000. It has one component, D-002-A: a US-source dividend from Orion Manufacturing via Atlas Acquisition SPV (P-009/P-010), per DOC-0202. Prepared to step 9. Steps 10-12 (second review and sign-off, release, recording) are not done. No case or schedule row was written; all access was read-only.

RECONCILIATION (C3.4): gross 8,000,000 equals the notice and the sum of the 12 distribution lines. Every payee line matches unit_pct at the record date x 8,000,000. Total tax 1,125,900; total net 6,874,100.
By outcome:
- Cleared: 5,743,000 gross, 516,100 tax.
- Default: 1,696,000 gross, 508,800 tax.
- Not applicable: 561,000.
- Held: none.
By payee:
- I-002 (1,920,000) is split to I-010, I-011 and I-012: 172,800 + 96,000 + 115,200 = 384,000 tax.
- I-007 (480,000) is split to I-013 and I-014: 144,000 tax.

KEY POINTS FOR REVIEWER:
1. Rule version: the pay date is in 2027, so the LU treaty rate is R-02 v2027.1 at 10% (Protocol 2026, AU-03, marked 'illustrative'), not v2026.1 at 15%. Please confirm the protocol is in force on 2027-01-12. R-03 (5%) has only v2026.1, with no end date. Please confirm the protocol does not change it.
2. I-003 at 5% under R-03 rests on an effective vote of exactly 10.00% (12.5% x 80%). I-004 just misses at 9.99%. Please confirm two things: that voting looked through the fund partnership and the SPV is accepted for the qualifying-holding test, and that the threshold is 'at least 10%'.
3. Look-through: recipients are the underlying owners. I-002 (transparent feeder, W-8IMY) splits 50/30/20 to I-010, I-011 and I-012 per the ALF1 commitments. F-002 has no withholding-statement document on file (doc_ref is null). I-007 (nonqualified intermediary) splits 62.5/37.5 to I-013 and I-014 per DOC-0107.
4. I-011 Moselle: residence changed to BE effective 2026-12-01. Notice DOC-0111 is indexed but not digitised, so its content has not been verified. The record shows recorded_dt 2026-12-20. Its LU treaty claim cannot be used, so I applied the 30% default. A new form is needed, and the rulebook has no BE treaty rule.
5. I-013 Echternach (S3.5): F-013 ends on 2026-12-31, before the pay date. It needs to go to WF2 with deadline 2027-01-12. If cured, the line becomes 10%: tax 30,000 instead of 90,000. There is also a discrepancy. DOC-0107 refers to a W-8BEN-E dated 4 March 2025 (TS-013 also starts 2025-03-04), but the form register only holds F-013, signed 2023-03-06. If a 2025 form exists, it may already cure the gap. Please check the form register.
6. I-006 Meridian I: CL-006 still shows 'cleared', but it relied on DO-003, which ended 2026-07-31. Change case K-006 (CE-001) is open, and the new structure is circular (I-006 and I-018 each own 30% of the other; a Jersey trust owns 70% of each). I treated the ownership-based LOB claim as unsupported and applied the 30% default pending K-006. Note that even before the change the sole owner was a Jersey trust, so the original LOB basis may need review. If K-006 reconfirms the claim, the line becomes 10% (24,000).
7. Defaults: I-011, I-006, I-013, I-014 and I-015. I chose default rather than hold because the LPA (DOC-0001) is not digitised and I could not confirm the fund's terms allow holds. Under C3.7, Investor Relations must notify these investors before payment with the cure item:
   - I-015: new W-8BEN-E.
   - I-014: owner certification through Sterling.
   - I-011: new form reflecting BE residence.
   - I-013: renewed W-8BEN-E.
   - I-006: updated ownership and LOB support.
8. Other data points:
   - I-008 and I-009 are different entities that share the name 'Alpha Holdings SA' (LU vs CH). They are kept separate.
   - The entity shareholding H-006 shows Co-Invest (I-016) at 3.5%, but its commitment and distribution line are 3%. This does not affect tax because the line is not applicable, but the 3.5% figure should be corrected.
   - System date is 2026-10-14, but the D-002 notice, the I-011 residence record and the P-009/P-010 payments are dated December 2026. Please confirm which data as-at date applies.
   - No obligation_assessment rows exist yet for D-002.
9. Rates: every rate below 30% cites a form, a rule version and Art. 10 (C3.3). The 30% 'cleared' lines (I-012, I-009) are documented investors with no treaty claim."}
